Look-alike numbers and conditions from the insurance, residency and registration pages, each tied to one handbook page; hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
The two bodily injury minimums differ by headcount, $25,000 for one person and $50,000 for two or more, while property damage has its own lower minimum of $15,000. [A01]
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F07.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Having a policy is only half the rule: the policy must come from an insurer licensed in Arizona and be an Arizona-based policy for where the vehicle is mostly driven. [A01]
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F05 versus sec02-F06.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Losing proper insurance or carrying a wrong VIN can suspend the vehicle registration and the driver license, not just the registration. [A01]
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty two; prereq sec02-F11.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
The seat belt requirement for a road test vehicle depends on model year, applying to 1972 and newer vehicles. [A01]
Why it matters: group road test; difficulty two; prereq sec02-F03.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A01
The National Driver Register can block an Arizona license because of unresolved actions in another state, while false statements on the application lead to cancellation of a license already issued. [A01]
Why it matters: group eligibility; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F14 versus sec02-F15.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
Residency by time is seven months in total within a calendar year, counted regardless of where your permanent home is, not seven consecutive months. [A02]
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty three; prereq sec02-F20.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A02
Seasonal agricultural work is the one kind of Arizona job that does not trigger residency. [A02]
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F17.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
Out-of-state students with seven or more semester hours stay non-residents even if employed, which overrides the general rule that working in Arizona makes you a resident. [A02]
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F22 versus sec02-F17.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
The voter age test is measured on the next General Election date, so an applicant who will be 18 on or before that date can register. [A02]
Why it matters: group voter registration; difficulty one; prereq sec02-F26.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A03
You must be registered 29 days before an election to vote in it, and moving to a new address means you must register to vote again. [A03]
Why it matters: group voter registration; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F29 versus sec02-F30.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A03
The medical condition indicator is an optional entry you request with documentation, whereas proof of a valid Social Security number is mandatory under state and federal law. [A03]
Why it matters: group application choices; difficulty one; confusable sec02-F34 versus sec02-F35.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0011]
